item_name: Rothco German Army Bundeswehr Type Blanket
item_short_desc: A military staple for reliable warmth & protection; wool blankets help you to brave the elements during camping trips, outdoor adventures, or during any day-to-day use.
description: A military staple for reliable warmth & protection; wool blankets help you to brave the elements during camping trips, outdoor adventures, or during any day-to-day use. This emergency blanket is constructed with a heavyweight yet breathable and comfortable 70% wool, 30% synthetic blend, designed to trap body heat, keeping you warm and dry. Created with a striped design this wool blanket is both functional and stylish. The wool blend makes this outdoor blanket fire-resistant, a major advantage for outdoor gear, while pico stitching around the edges aid in rugged, long-lasting use of this camping blanket. The easily transportable blanket folds up to compactly fit in your backpack, bug out bag, or survival bag and is great for camping, backpacking, hunting, hiking or in survival situations. Use this military blanket as extra bedding or, for emergency situations.
